schema.description: A client exports the principal's calendar as iCalendar, together with the receipts the VTA keeps — what the member takes with them, whether or not any community still answers. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

contextIds.description: Only these contexts. Absent: every context the caller has standing in (VTI-CAL-002).

cursor.description: An opaque cursor from a previous response's `nextCursor`, for the same caller and filters; the VTA refuses one it did not issue.

from.description: Only entries ending after this. Absent: no lower bound.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the VTA chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

to.description: Only entries starting before this. Absent: no upper bound.
